cd /workspace && timeout 60 python -c "
from rich.cells import split_graphemes, cell_len
print(split_graphemes('\ufe0fabc'))
print(split_graphemes('a\ufe0f'))
print(cell_len('\ufe0f'), cell_len('\u2764\ufe0f'))
" && timeout 150 python -m pytest tests/test_cells.py -x -q 2>&1 | tail -3

turns.reply: I fixed the infinite loop in `split_graphemes` (`rich/cells.py`) by making the variation-selector branch always advance the index, so a leading `\ufe0f` with no preceding character no longer spins forever. The `tests/test_cells.py` suite passes (56 tests), and a direct check of `'\ufe0fabc'` and `'a\ufe0f'` now returns. I did not reproduce the original hang with a test before the change, so the fix is verified by the ran checks rather than a regression test.
